definitions.explanation: Describes a tendency to engage with the outside world, embrace new connections, or focus on external matters. Used for personalities, organizations, or national policies.

examples.japanese: {外向|そとむ}きな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧だ。
examples.english: She's a person with an outgoing personality.

examples.japanese: ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧{外向|そとむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: We need a more outward-looking business strategy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外向|そとむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}し→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{開拓|かいたく}→開拓：09954_kaitaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れている→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The government has adopted an outward-looking stance and is putting effort into developing overseas markets.

notes:
The counterpart of ⟦{内向|うちむ}き→内向き：26799_uchimuki⟧. Used for both personal disposition (extroverted, sociable) and broader orientations of organizations or nations (internationally engaged, open to the world).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外向|そとむ}きな⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: outgoing personality
- {外向|そとむ}きな⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: outward-looking stance
- {外向|そとむ}き⟦{志向|しこう}→志向：12607_shikou⟧: outward-oriented tendency

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外向的|がいこうてき}→外向的：08459_gaikouteki⟧: extroverted — specifically for personality; more psychological
- ⟦{内向|うちむ}き→内向き：26799_uchimuki⟧: inward-looking — the direct opposite
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: proactive; positive — implies willingness to take action
